name: Almond Macaroons
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sweet almonds blanched and pounded fine
ingredients.originalText: 6 ounces sweet almonds blanched and pounded fine

instructions.text: Blanch and pound fine 6 ounces sweet almonds
Mix in a large bowl the whites of 2 eggs and 12 ounces powdered sugar
Beat with a wooden spoon for 5 minutes
Drop through pastry tube in pieces about the size of a quarter on sheets of buttered paper, in baking pans
Bake in a slow oven until cakes are golden brown

source.originalInstructions:
1. Blanch and pound fine 6 ounces sweet almonds
2. Mix in a large bowl the whites of 2 eggs and 12 ounces powdered sugar
3. Beat with a wooden spoon for 5 minutes
4. Drop through pastry tube in pieces about the size of a quarter on sheets of buttered paper, in baking pans
5. Bake in a slow oven until cakes are golden brown
